body: Skip OS top-level temp roots (`tmpdir()`, `/tmp`, `/private/tmp`, `/var/tmp`) in `lib/active-rails.mjs` (`findAdlcRoot`) and `bin/hook-runner.sh` (`has_adlc_ancestor`) just like `$HOME` and `/` so a stray `/tmp/.adlc` session ledger never hijacks projects or test fixtures under `/tmp`.
title: Skip OS temp roots (/tmp, tmpdir) in findAdlcRoot and has_adlc_ancestor
